data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC extends recovery, ETH eyes $2,500, XRP holds $1.30 | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) extend their recovery, trading above $76,700, $2,400 and $1.300, respectively, on Friday. These top three cryptocurrencies now face key technical levels that could determine whether their recoveries extend further or pull back.
